versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "scraping-youtube-playlist" skill.
- Extracts video metadata (title, URL, stats, description, duration, channel info) from YouTube playlists using apidojo's scraper on Apify.
- Supports input via playlist URLs, keyword searches, and configurable output limits.
- Raw data collection for use by content curators, educators, and channel analysts.
- Handles edge cases like private, deleted, or very large playlists.
